textRule: Native Rust String is projected to its complete canonical UTF8 bytes. Valid UTF8 byte lists uniquely reconstruct the native String; positive byte model does not implement or certify UTF8 validation/decoding/admission. Length prefix counts bytes, not Unicode scalars/chars.
typeExprRule: Field.ty tree is projected preorder: UInt/Bool/List/Tree nullary token; Named/Param name bytes token; Apply{name bytes,arity} then each child subtree in original left-to-right order. Apply witharity0 has one token and no child. Positive tokens satisfy one finite complete tree; preorder+arity uniquely reconstruct args grouping. No desired codec output participates.
allOtherData: Entry, all22tables, every row/field/order/duplicate/rawslice/option/marker/rawu128 exact. No sorting/filtering/dedup/empty-slice normalization.
modelLimitation: Future Quint decoded_program is full byte/preorder projection of ProgramSnapshot; it is not direct native String/recursive-AST execution. This explicit external projection relation is required for any Rust common-domain claim.
